title: White Miso Sushi Sauce
description: A miso-forward, pourable dipping and brushing sauce for sushi. No honey and no added sugar.
steps: Simmer mirin and water gently for 2–3 minutes to mellow the alcohol; top up evaporated water if necessary.
Remove from heat, cool until lukewarm, and whisk in white miso until smooth.
Whisk in unseasoned rice vinegar and optional sesame oil. Thin with 2–3 ml water at a time if needed.
Refrigerate until cool. Use as a small dipping sauce, or brush approximately 2 g onto individual salmon nigiri pieces.
notes: No honey and no additional sugar. The white miso and mirin contribute gentle sweetness.
This is a separate reusable sushi sauce, not a miso glaze for cooking salmon.
Keep refrigerated and serve raw fish separately from stored sauce.
White miso salinity varies by brand.
